title: Welcome to Your New Free Website
text: 🚀 Getting Started Welcome to Your New Free Website Congratulations! Your website template is deployed and ready on Cloudflare Pages & Workers . ✨ Core Capabilities 100% Free Hosting: Powered by Cloudflare's ultra-fast global edge network. Telegram Bot CMS: Post documentation, manage comments, answer inquiries, and check stats directly from Telegram. Admin Dashboard: Access /admin to moderate content and view live site statistics. Fully Customizable: Configure every detail using the .env file. Documentation & Contact: Dynamic documentation library, real-time search, and interactive contact system. 🛠 Next Steps Open your .env file to customize your site title, author name, links, and colors. Add your BOT_TOKEN and CHAT_ID to enable the Telegram CMS. Double-click deploy.bat anytime to publish your changes instantly! ← Back to Documentation

title: Customization & Telegram CMS Guide
text: 🛠 Documentation Customization & Telegram CMS Guide This website is built to be managed easily from your phone via Telegram or from your local machine via the .env file. 1. Setting Up Telegram CMS Open Telegram and message @BotFather to create a new bot (run /newbot ). Copy the HTTP API Token provided by BotFather. Message @userinfobot in Telegram to get your numeric Chat ID . Open your .env file and add: BOT_TOKEN=your_token_here CHAT_ID=your_numeric_chat_id Double-click deploy.bat to upload your secrets and activate your webhook automatically! 2. Telegram Bot Commands /start : Main admin control menu. /add_note : Send any document, PDF, or text note to publish instantly. /stats : Check real-time site visitor metrics. /announce : Set or update the live notification banner on your website. 3. Managing Inquiries & Q&A When a visitor fills out the contact form on your site, you will receive an alert on Telegram with a unique inquiry ID. Simply reply directly to that message on Telegram to respond or publish the answer! ← Back to Documentation
